titulo: Unit 2: Past Tenses & Professional Travel (RA1, RA2)

paginas.contenido:
Unit 2 covers past actions and the vocabulary needed for professional travel and giving directions within a technical facility.
  • RA1 & RA2: Understanding technical instructions and documentation about past incidents or configurations.
  • Grammar Goals: Mastering the Past Simple and Past Continuous, and the structure 'Used to' for past habits.
  • Vocabulary: Giving directions, travel-related phrasal verbs, and IT maintenance tasks.

💡 Nota: Esta unidad es clave para redactar informes de incidencias (lo que pasó) y para moverte en entornos laborales.

When working in a large data center or office, you need to know how to guide colleagues.
  • Go straight on: Sigue recto.
  • Turn left/right: Gira a la izquierda/derecha.
  • Opposite: Enfrente de (no lleva 'to').
  • Next to: Al lado de.
  • At the intersection: En el cruce/intersección.

💡 Nota: 'The office is opposite the server room' significa que están una frente a la otra.

Common verbs used when traveling for business or attending conferences.
  • Set off: To begin a journey (partir).
  • Check in: To register at a hotel or airport.
  • Hold up: To delay (retrasar). "The flight was held up."
  • Get in: To arrive (llegar).

Used for completed actions in the past.

Structure:

Subject + Verb-ed (or irregular form)

Examples:

  • "The IT team backed up all the files."
  • "I finished the report yesterday."
  • "The system crashed last night."

💡 Nota: Usamos el Past Simple con marcas de tiempo como 'yesterday', 'last week' o 'two hours ago'.

Used for actions that were in progress at a specific time in the past, or interrupted by another action.

Structure:

Subject + Was/Were + Verb-ing

Examples:

  • "While the team was testing the software, they found bugs."
  • "They were installing the update when the power went out."
  • "I was working in the lab at 10 PM."

💡 Nota: 'While' suele ir con Past Continuous y 'When' con Past Simple.

Used for past habits or states that are no longer true.

Structure:

Subject + Used to + Verb (infinitive)

Examples:

  • "She used to work as a network admin." (She doesn't anymore).
  • "The company used to have older servers."

💡 Nota: No lo confundas con 'be used to' (estar acostumbrado).

Review these core concepts for Unit 2.
  • Directions: 'Opposite' (enfrente), 'Next to' (al lado).
  • Travel: 'Set off' (partir), 'Check in' (registrarse), 'Held up' (retrasado).
  • Past Simple: Completed actions ("I installed it").
  • Past Continuous: Actions in progress ("I was installing it").
  • Used to: Past habits ("I used to study IT").
Complete this test to confirm you have mastered the Unit 2 content.

preguntas_test.q: To get to the main office, you need to __________ (turn) left at the next intersection.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Después de 'need to' usamos el infinitivo.

preguntas_test.q: They __________ (install) the new software when the system crashed.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Acción larga interrumpida por una puntual (crashed) = Past Continuous.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'We were working when the alarm rang.'

preguntas_test.q: The data center is __________ to the security office.
preguntas_test.explicacion: 'Opposite' no lleva 'to'. 'Next to' sí lo lleva.

preguntas_test.q: The flight was __________ (hold up) due to technical issues.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Voz pasiva en pasado (was + participio). 'Held' es el participio de 'hold'.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'The project was held up by the manager.'

preguntas_test.q: She __________ (use) to work as a network administrator before switching careers.
preguntas_test.explicacion: 'Used to' indica un hábito pasado que ya no ocurre.

preguntas_test.q: While the team __________ (test) the new software, they found several bugs.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Con 'while' solemos usar el Past Continuous.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'While I was reading, the phone rang.'

preguntas_test.q: The IT team __________ (backup) all the files before the system update.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Acción completada en el pasado = Past Simple.

preguntas_test.q: We are __________ (plan) to upgrade the network next month.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Presente continuo con doblado de consonante (CVC).

preguntas_test.q: We will __________ (set off) on our business trip early tomorrow.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Después de 'will' usamos la forma base. 'Set' es irregular.

preguntas_test.q: Make sure to __________ (check in) at the hotel by 3 PM.
